scope: Portable graph export, host CPU numerical parity, training-only static PTQ and existing evaluation sensitivity. No Vivado build, FPGA mapping, PYNQ runtime or fresh unseen-test claim.

export.output: Identity L2-normalised576vector; YOLO end-to-end NMS-free original trained detection head with postprocess retained

detector.preprocess: Ultralytics LetterBox(new_shape320x320,auto=True,stride32) on native2560x1440 photos, BGRtoRGB, NCHW,float/255. Output shape verified192x320. Resize/letterbox and confidence filtering are host steps outside exported core.
detector.test_inputs: 7native photos saved in video_chain, plus seeded non-tied synthetic input only if needed for sanity
detector.parity: Coordinate and score numerical differences plus confidence>=0.2 boxes, use same locked checkpoint; topK row order ties are not identity correspondence

identity.calibration_for_quantiser: First64 paths by SHA256(ptq-calibration-v1:+relative_path) among training-split images only; no gallery/query validation/evaluation
identity.quantisation: ORT static QuantFormat.QDQ, activations QUInt8, weights QInt8 symmetric per-channel, Conv ops only, minmax calibration; other ops remain FP32 and graph I/O remain float. No all-int8 claim.
identity.quantiser_selection: Predeclared single recipe, not tuned to evaluation
identity.thresholds: Separate QDQ threshold on validation_gallery/query only; write all3seed threshold files before any quantised evaluation input forward. Frozen FP32 parity compared to previous thresholds/results.
identity.metrics: All3seeds FP32 vs QDQ, closedTop1 and correct/wrong/rejected/unknown counts; do not pick a best seed

graph_audit: stored parameter/constant bytes, Conv multiply-accumulate count at stated shape
largest inferred tensor, conservative static liveness sketch with assumptions (not BRAM/DSP synthesis report)
QDQ integer initializer bytes and remaining float operators

board_reference.comparison: Compare graph and observed host footprint to reference sizes only. Runtime, line buffers, DMA and concurrency require board data; weights may stream from DDR.

acceptance: Graph checker and actual ORT CPU forward pass
Frozen identity FP32 vectors and gallery decisions agree within declared tolerance
No PTQ calibration identity overlaps validation/evaluation
All calibration recipes and output hashes logged; original checkpoints preserved
Do not generate hardware construction scripts before board image and tool versions arrive
